definitions.visitors: — unique IP address dem weh Cloudflare si dat dei. I klos to pesin dem, bot i no sem exact: wan office weh dei fo wan connection, dem count-am wan taim, an wan phone weh di muv bitwin wifi an mobile data, dem count-am tuways.
definitions.pageViews: — request dem weh Cloudflare di classify lek page load dem, no be picture dem, script dem or API call dem.
definitions.bots: — dis dem na raw edge count dem, so crawler dem, uptime monitor dem an scripted client dem dei insaid. Yu fit si-am yuaself fo di browser breakdown weh dei op, wia entry dem lek “Curl” an “Unknown” na automated traffic, no be pesin dem. For filter bot dem komot, i nid wan paid Cloudflare tier weh wi no di run, an if wi kwaitli subtract wan estimate i go mek di number dem les checkable, no moa checkable.
definitions.total: — page view dem an request dem di add op across di range. Visitor count dem, dem no purposely sum-am go wan headline “total visitors”, bikos som pesin weh dei ya Monday an Tuesday go dem count-am tuways.
definitions.peakTerm: Awa / dei weh get plenti activity pas
definitions.peak: — di haiest unique count fo eni wan bucket fo di range, fo di sem reason: na wan figure weh Cloudflare actually di measure-am, no be wan weh dem build-am bai adding count dem weh overlap.
definitions.resolution: — na Cloudflare i limit fo dis plan, i no be choice: i di refuse eni hourly query weh pas tri dei. Di 24-awa an 3-dei view dem na hourly; 7 dei an moa na daily, an no wei dei for draw wan hourly chart for all-time.
definitions.breakdown: — dis dem di follow di range weh yu pick, bot na only bak {{max}} dei dem, weh na so far di per-dei breakdown dei kept. Fo longa range dem, di chart di kova moa taim pas wetin di country list di kova.
definitions.start: — “all time” min sei eni dei weh Cloudflare stil di keep-am, weh tudei na {{days}} dei weh start {{date}}, di dei weh dehub.io muv go Cloudflare. No earlier edge data dei for sho, an oda dei dem weh olda dem di komot wen Cloudflare don age dem out.
definitions.estimated: — since {{date}}, dehub.io dei pass for wan relay server so dat network dem weh no fit reach Cloudflare direct fit still load di site. So Cloudflare dei si most visitor dem as di relay i wan address, an i unique count fall plenty. Fo dat dei dem, di chart dei sho di page view dem weh we measure, multiply by di normal visitor-per-page-view ratio fo di {{days}} dei dem befo ({{ratio}}%). Page view dem an request dem still dei measure direct, an Cloudflare i count weh nobody touch dei fo di raw response weh we link fo up.

depin.heroBlurb: Give your extra storage, bandwidth and compute make e help host, transcode and deliver DeHub content.
depin.heroImageAlt: Wetin wey be a small computer box dat fit inside house, connect to people house, and studio for creator, make dey do fast calculation close to dem, no need send everything to big server far away.
depin.heroCaption: DeHub keep de original copy. Community node add strong copy (replica) and local delivery power.
depin.earlyAccessBody: Lightweight, browser-based node dey open down below. Heavy, always-on desktop node dey talk about for future, but no dey come yet. Participation no guarantee reward.
depin.statUnavailable: Na go long wey wey, no go dey now.
depin.optInBlurb: Dis tier run a whole inside browser you, use local storage (OPFS). Na dis tier, only contribute when dis tab stay open — close im, node you stop, open im again, new node start. No install, no background run.
depin.unsupportedTitle: Na browser yu no support dis a thing
depin.rejectedBlurb: Network say no go fit dis node session, nae nae mean nae expire while page still open. Sign in again, go choose yes — no go lose anyfing.
depin.dhbEarnedThisPeriod: Token wey you earn dis period
depin.threeJobsTitle: Won node, tree wey fit for work, three job.
depin.threeJobsBody: Operators dey choose own storage, bandwidth, na compute limit. DeHub dey schedule only work dat machine dey safe handle.
depin.transcodeImageAlt: Creator workstation for house wey di give extra GPU compute
depin.transcodeBody: Mashin wey fit na dem wey upload video naa, turn dem naa video wey adaptable. Every output wey come out, check dem first before dem go serve.
depin.hostBody: Nodes di keep encrypted or content-addressed pieces for small local cache wey get limit. DeHub origin storage still bi the main source.
depin.deliverBody: Pea pea na wey yu nea, dem share video clip, but wey yu go na wey normal, dem stay ready go back up automatic.
depin.nodesLeaveTitle: Na network wey na expect node go leave, wey na expect node go go away.
depin.nodesLeaveBody: No komyuniti makina no hold wey only copy. Heles check, replika, and origin fallback keep playback wey available.
depin.originBody: Main source copy wey no di go and backup delivery
depin.availableReplicasBody: Seri wey a go dey close na segment wey a be verify, close na wey a go dey fit demand
depin.offlineNodeBody: Remove go long route until it reconnect again
depin.viewerBody: Use a friend if dey be around, use origin if need be.
depin.privacyTitle: Hosts na store pees, no access.
depin.privacyBody: Media wey go protect, still stay encrypt on computer wey community use. Key wey go play, go give separate fi person wey go watch, na person wey go get authorise.
depin.protectedContentBody: Subscriber, private and pay-per-view pieces fit di stored as ciphertext. Node operators no di get access keys just because dem host data.
depin.publicContentBody: Enkripshon no stop casual inspection of cache file, but public media still dey watchable through public DeHub player. We no go claim different.
depin.operatorControlsBody: Operators naam disk limit, bandwidth limit, workin hour, naa eligible public content categories. Removal notice dem trigger cache clear.
depin.verifiedWorkTitle: Wok yu na usefu, na reward na still move-move. No fix.
depin.verifiedWorkBody: Dem di measure contribution with signed receipts, health checks and output checks. Storage alone no di bring reward.
depin.deliveryReceiptsBody: Verified bytes wey go dey play real time for session.
depin.availabilityBody: Retrieval checks wey pass and service wey di reliable when dem give am work.
depin.validOutputBody: Transcodes must pass technical checks and quality checks wey dem sample.
depin.revenuePoolBody: Naa, if wey wey activate, budget for reward go dey come from revenue wey platform get after epoch finish.
depin.noFixedRate: No get fixed rate, minimum return, APY or forward estimate. Contribution record na only for accounting, no be promise of payment. Any future token settlement go happen for Base and remain subject to eligibility, network rule and applicable law.
depin.runningCosts: Run a node sey use electricity, data internet, na hardware life. Operator no get nafa, na cost wey dem dey exceed any reward wey dem get.
depin.safestWorkloadTitle: We build am from the safest work go outside.
depin.safestWorkloadBody: DePin na go add extra path fo delivery wey DeHub na dey use first. After wey dem confirm verification dey strong, dem go dey send heavy workloads.
depin.deliveryBody: Peer-to-peer live and video streaming, automatic switch to backup if connection weak.
depin.adaptiveVideoBody: Different quality versions so playback go di steady for any connection speed.
depin.desktopNodesBody: Storage wey get limit, bandwidth control and availability wey dem don check.
depin.baseSettlementBody: Claims wey revenue di fund only after operation and legal review.
depin.faqOfflineQ: Weti go happen when hosting node go offline?
depin.faqOfflineA: Na coordinator remove e go from active route. Another replica take care of e segment, or playback fall back to DeHub origin storage while replacement copies dey schedule.
depin.faqCanOperatorSeeQ: Node operator fit see di content we dem host?
depin.faqCanOperatorSeeA: Content wey go protect, dey store as encrypted segments, na host no dey get playback key. Content wey go public, still dey visible for everybody through DeHub, na design wey so.
depin.faqHowMuchQ: How much node operator go collect?
depin.faqHowMuchA: Wetin no dey fixed rate or forekast. Contribution wey confirm, dem go get share wey come from reward pool wey dey fund by revenue, after epoch finish. Reward no guarantee, na. Cost wey come from electricity, bandwidth, and hardware, dem go be more dan reward wey dey.
depin.faqSoftwareAvailableQ: Node software don di available now?
depin.faqSoftwareAvailableA: Lightweight browser-based node wey dey now: sign in and choose yes on dis page, and your open tab go dey like a node while you keep it open. Heavy, always-on desktop node wey dey as future plan — no dey exist yet.
depin.faqInstallNeededQ: I need install anything for the browser node?
depin.faqInstallNeededA: No. E go run wey wey inside tab, use browser local storage. Close tab, node wey wey stop. No background service, no install.
depin.ctaTitle: Launch only when e safe if something fail.
depin.ctaBody: Origin backup, encrypted protected media and work wey dem don check go come first before any public node reward.
depin.footerNote: DePin participation na contribution service, e no bi investment product. Availability, who fit join and rewards fit change.

glossary.fractionsDesc: Post weh dem mint for DeHub go turn NFT weh dem divide for 1,000 fraction, and the creator go start with all 1,000 — 100% ownership for the content. Minting na your choice, and e fit happen when you di publish or later.
glossary.ownershipBarDesc: Progress bar for Post Info page weh di show how many of the 1,000 fraction the creator still hold and how many done share or sell.
glossary.tokenIdDesc: One special on-chain ID weh post di get when dem mint am as NFT for blockchain. Minting na your choice, so post weh dem never mint no get Token ID yet.
glossary.tokenIdInfoDesc: The special on-chain ID weh post di get once dem don mint am as NFT. E di show for top of Post Info page for post dem weh dem don mint.
glossary.tipDesc: Senda DeHub tokns direkti to a kontent kreator as a rewod for dia kontent. Tipes dey rekord on-chain.
glossary.totalTipsDesc: Show wey total amoun o post earn as tip from viewer, display for wey Post Info page.
glossary.listFractionsDesc: Ef you own small part of post, you can put dem for sell at price you choose (in token per small part). Other people can buy dem small part you put for sell.
glossary.walletDesc: Yu wallet wey dey hold yu DeHub tokens anodda kripto asets. Connected via Web3Auth for easy access.
glossary.stakingDesc: Yu lock ya DeHub tokens, yu go earn reward dey time go come. Tokens wey dey stake also give yu increase power to vote for governance.
glossary.stakingBadgeDesc: Badges wey show next to your name wey dey base on your total DeHub token dey keep (wallet + wey you stake). Dem have 13 level—more token you keep, higher your badge level go. Level high dey give you more power to vote for governance and lower platform fee. Level dey price in dollar, so number of token each level cost go down when token price rise—an once you earn a level, you keep it as long as you keep what cost you, no matter what price do after dat.
glossary.thumbsUpDesc: Wen yu like or agree wit post. Increase post engagement score and help am rank high in feed.
glossary.thumbsDownDesc: Wen yu dislike or disagree wit post. Dis feedback help improve content recommendation.
glossary.commentDesc: Open koment section where yu kan reply to post, join discuss, and interact wit odas user.
glossary.shareDesc: Share post externally via link, or copy post URL to clipboard to send to odas.
glossary.bookmarkDesc: Save post to bukmark for later. Access all save post from Bukmark page in sidebar.
glossary.reportDesc: Flag inappropriate or harmfull content for review. Report help keep komuniti safe.
glossary.moreOptionsDesc: Open additional action like edit, delete, or report post.
glossary.translateButtonDesc: Translat post text, bio, and koment into yu prefer language. App auto-detect yu browser language or yu set one manuali in Setting.
glossary.showOriginalDesc: Afua translat, tap dis to revert back to original language of content.
glossary.imagePostDesc: Post wey get one or plenti image. Dem de store image for blockchain as NFT wit unique Token ID.
glossary.videoPostDesc: Post wey get video. You fit set video make e bi public, private, or pay-per-view (PPV).
glossary.liveStreamDesc: Broadcast wey de happen for real time. People wey de watch fit comment and dash the person wey de stream. Stream de use low-latency HLS technology.
glossary.storyDesc: Short video wey de comot afta 24 hour. Tap the ring for person im avatar for home feed to watch im story.
glossary.audioDesc: Audio post wey get visual waveform player. Creators fit upload music, podcast, or voice record.
glossary.audioSpaceDesc: Live audio room wia people fit talk, listen, and raise hand to join the talk.
glossary.publicDesc: Content wey everybody fit see. Anybody fit watch, like, and comment for public post.
glossary.privateDesc: Content wey only you fit see. Private post de hide from oda people and from the public feed.
glossary.subscriberOnlyDesc: Content wey only people wey don subscribe to the creator im channel fit see.
glossary.postInfoPageDesc: Detailed view of any post wey de show im on-chain data, how people de interact wit am, ownership fraction, and creator info. You fit see am if you tap the "ⓘ" icon for any post.
glossary.txHashInfoDesc: The blockchain transaction hash from the time wey dem mint the post. Click am to open the block explorer (BaseScan or BscScan) and check the on-chain record.
glossary.engagementStatsDesc: The Post Info page de show total like, dislike, view, comment, and dash wey the post don get — e de give you full picture of how the post de perform.
glossary.visibilityControlDesc: Post owner fit change how people de see im post, whether Public (anybody fit see), Unlisted (only via direct link), or Private (only you). You fit do am from the Post Info page.
glossary.unlistedDesc: Visibility setting wia the post no go show for feed or search, but anybody wey get the direct link fit still see am.
glossary.ppvPurchasesDesc: For pay-per-view post, show wey number of user dey buy access, and total money creator dey earn.
glossary.fractionMarketplaceDesc: Market tab wey dey Post Info paje, wey fraction holders fit list dema fractions for sale and buyers fit make offer. Dis one dey make trading of content ownership possible.
glossary.makeOfferDesc: M chapa 1/4 post fo post fo Facebook, na 5000 naira. M chapa 1/2 post fo 8000 naira, 3/4 post fo 12000 naira, na full post fo 15000 naira.
glossary.swapDesc: Excheyn wan tokn for anoda direkt insaid app. Swaps hapen on-chain usin dezentralizd excheynz.
glossary.txHashDesc: Transaksion ID. Klik am view full transaksion details for blockchain explorer.
glossary.followersDesc: Yu go follow pipo wey dey post, na dem go dey show for yu profile.
glossary.notificationsDesc: Alerts for laik, komment, tip, folo, and anoda aktiviti wey dey relate to your akount.
glossary.dmDesc: Mesaji pribat wey dey available for mobile app, web go dey come soon.
glossary.mentionDesc: Yu go tag anoda pesin wey dey for dia post or koment, yu go type @ followed by dia username. Dia go receive notis.
glossary.homeFeedDesc: Wetin you see fit be post from people you follow na trending content wey dey show for you.
glossary.exploreDesc: Dishover new kontent and users. Brouz by katagori: vidiyo, imaji, laif strem, and mor.
glossary.leaderboardDesc: Rankin of top users by balans, tips sent, tips receive, folowers, and mor. Updatd periodikli.
glossary.assistantDesc: AI na power wey go help you talk, answer question, make picture, create video, and help you use platform feature.
glossary.settingsDesc: Manej yor akount prefrens, langwij, priwasi setings, and apirans.
glossary.featureRequestsDesc: Sugest new feeshuns and vot on komuniti ideas. Popul rekest get prioritis for devlopment.
glossary.upvoteDesc: Vote fo’ support a governance proposal or feature request. Den help show dat community dey support.
glossary.downvoteDesc: Vot against goment proposal or fetish request. Help signal komuniti opozishun.
glossary.deltaDesc: Dey green or red arrow wey fit na side a eni entry a leaderboard, dem show how much balance a user get wey dey change for time period wey dem select (1 day, 1 week, etc.).
glossary.deleteDesc: Permanent remove post from feed. On-chain record still stay, but content no longer show.
glossary.viewOnExplorerDesc: Yon open blockchain explorer (BaseScan) fi view transaction details for post or transfer.
glossary.title: Glossary
glossary.subtitle: Learn weti every icon and feature mean

badgeLadder.intro: Each tier cost one fixed amount for dollars. The token figure wey dey beside am na wetin dat one cost for $0.001 reference price — di app dey ask for dat figure scaled to di live price, and never for more than am, so one falling price no fit raise di bar or take back one tier wey you don already earn.

postingAllowance.footnote: Badge tier na your DeHub tokens wey you hold plus wey you stake for BNB Chain and Base — e be the same balance wey your badge dey come from. The ladder get price for dollars, so the token figures wey dey above na wetin each tier cost for the $0.001 sale price and the requirement dey fall as the token price dey rise; a tier wey you don already earn, dem no go ever take am back because of the price. A badge wey your patron lend you dey show for your profile but e no dey increase your posting allowance — that one dey come from wetin you hold yourself. Allowances reset at 00:00 UTC, and a gigabyte here na 1,024 MB.

accountDeletion.title: Delete your account
accountDeletion.description: Delete your account and your personal data for good
accountDeletion.warning: Dis one go delete yu DeHub profile, yu posts, comments, messages an di wallet backup weh yu don save, fo ever. Save yu wallet recovery details an move any asset weh yu get first. Public blockchain transaction dem an payment record weh law say make we keep, dem no fit delete. Yu profile go hide one time; di deletion go finish inside 30 days. Yu no fit undo dis one.
